register.reg_long_name: MPAM Virtual Partition Mapping Valid Register
register.reg_condition: when (FEAT_MPAMv0p1 is implemented or FEAT_MPAMv1p0 is implemented), FEAT_AA64EL2 is implemented, and MPAMIDR_EL1.HAS_HCR == '1'

purpose_text.para: Valid bits for virtual PARTID mapping entries. Each bit m corresponds to virtual PARTID mapping entry m in the MPAMVPM<n>_EL2 registers where n = m >> 2.

configuration_text.para: This register has no effect if EL2 is not enabled in the current Security state.

field_description.para: Contains valid bit for virtual PARTID mapping entry corresponding to virtual PARTID<m>.

ps.name: MRS
MSRregister
